-- AUTO DUMP PRO

local function save(tag, data)
    local name = tag .. "_" .. os.time() .. ".lua"
    writefile(name, data)
    print(" Saved:", name)
end

-- Hook loadstring (QUAN TRNG NHT)
local old_loadstring = loadstring
loadstring = function(code)
    print(" loadstring caught")
    save("loadstring", code)
    return old_loadstring(code)
end

-- Hook tostring (bt thêm my dng encode)
local old_tostring = tostring
tostring = function(v)
    local s = old_tostring(v)
    if type(v) == "string" and #v > 100 then
        save("tostring", v)
    end
    return s
end
